items.text:
It's not a game.

That's not even ironic. It's literally a first person visual novel about a sad sod who got stood up from his date.

3/10 - points for letting me pick the topic of his conversation and move his hands in first person. However, the lack of anything game like in the ... "game"... makes for an akward experience. It's a linear, fly-on-the-wall style graphic novel. That is all.
items.text_zh:
这不是一款游戏。

这甚至都不是反讽。它字面上就是一部第一人称视觉小说，讲一个被约会对象放了鸽子的可怜虫。

3/10——给分是因为它让我能选择他谈话的话题，还能以第一人称移动他的手。然而，这个……“游戏”……里缺乏任何像游戏的东西，导致体验很尴尬。它是一部线性的、旁观者视角的图像小说。仅此而已。

observations.description: 缺乏游戏性，只是线性观看的视觉小说

items.text:
Short and somewhat entertaining. No gameplay to speak of. I'm fine with narrative games and it's kindof interesting but...It feels pretty hollow. Doesn't really go anywhere. Its concept isn't really that amazing either. You are the subconcious of a person but really...You're not, you're just the person.
If it was free I'd say, go ahead, check it out. But it'll only last you less than an hour of entertainment. But it's not. So don't bother. Watch a gameplay video it's pretty much the same thing anyways. Or just watch a television show or something. It's a narrative but considering it's length and lack of characters there's nothing really enticing about it. 'Nuff said.
items.text_zh:
短小且还算有点意思。谈不上有什么玩法。我对叙事类游戏没什么意见，而且它还算有点意思，但是……感觉相当空洞。并没有真正发展到哪里去。它的概念其实也没那么惊艳。你是某个人的潜意识，但实际上……你并不是，你只是那个人。
如果它是免费的，我会说，去吧，去看看。但它只能给你不到一小时的娱乐。可它不是免费的。所以别费心了。看个游戏实况视频，反正基本上是一回事。或者干脆看个电视节目什么的。它是个叙事作品，但考虑到它的长度和角色的匮乏，实在没什么真正吸引人的地方。不用多说了。

items.text: Decent game, however, not worth the money. It's an interesting concept having the player listen to the character's thoughts as he goes through a "rough night". It's very mindless. The actions are relatively arbitrary and serve no purpose to the story line. I only recommend this game if you are stoned out of your mind and want to kill about 25 minutes.
items.text_zh: 还算不错的游戏，然而不值这个钱。让玩家在角色经历一个“糟糕夜晚”时聆听他的想法，是个有趣的概念。这非常无脑。那些动作相对随意，对故事情节毫无作用。我只推荐给那些嗑药嗑到神志不清、想消磨大约25分钟的人。
